name: Iron Attic Key

source.note: Death House area 8: the library desk holds the key to the padlock on the children's room (area 20).

summary: A plain iron key from the drawer of the Dursts' library desk.
text: A plain iron key, cold and a little rusty, kept in the top drawer of the library desk in Death House. It fits the padlock on a door in the attic.
